content: agent-tui is intended to provide one agent-neutral TUI protocol and presentation surface. Concrete agent protocols belong behind the AgentHost/AgentRemote adaptor boundary; ACP adaptor family and selection are an extension target, not a claim that multiple ACP agents are currently implemented.
title: Agent-neutral TUI boundary

content: Root durable memory records verified cross-project context and reusable lessons, not a copy of child project history. Entries are classified as plan, path, knowledge, or lesson; uncertain observations remain in run notes until verified.
title: Memory rebuild policy

content: The root agent-plugins project is the AppSDK Guidance surface for agent-tui, agent-memory, Teams, and dsh-concurrency-limit. Root Guidance coordinates cross-project context; each child project keeps its own contracts, maps, lifecycle records, Active, Protected, evidence, and history. agent-memory is pending until its canonical source is present on the root baseline.
title: Root scope and ownership
